note: Optional per-region overrides of feature normalisation curves and weights. Resolution falls back from district ('kerala__wayanad') to state ('kerala') to the global default in risk_weights.json. Overriding a feature merges into its global definition, so a profile need only restate what actually differs.
why_this_ships_empty: The same rainfall total does not carry the same meaning in Rajasthan and Assam, and the architecture supports expressing that. No overrides are configured, because none could be defended: there is no labelled Indian flash-flood event dataset available to this project to fit region-specific thresholds against, and inventing plausible-looking numbers to improve a demonstration would be a fabrication. Today the locally-meaningful signal is carried by the rainfall_anomaly feature, which is expressed as a percentile of each location's OWN ERA5 history and is therefore already region-relative without any per-region configuration.
how_to_add_one: Add an entry under 'profiles' keyed by state slug or district id. Only the scoring CONFIGURATION changes - the weighted-sum arithmetic in risk_models.py is shared by every region and is never branched or duplicated.

some_state_slug.label: Human-readable name for the profile
